name: Noujou Hitomi
source: She had a daughter: [url=/c28327]Noujou Mayura[/url]. She is often seen in front of her daughter's grave, mourning and praying. Her death was too much for her to the point where she feels dead herself. Hitomi's husband also died a long time ago, but she isn't as obsessed about him as Mayura.
